title: Talent Acquisition Specialist JR (trilingual)
description:
Customer Intelligence Inc. is a professional consulting service and marketing firm, providing cutting-edge services to help customers grow. CI specializes in the financial industry, Customer Intelligence Inc. also works with clients across multiple industries, payment brands, processing systems, and other enterprises with a focus on LATAM.

Do you want to be a part of a collaborative environment?

Are you motivated to stay on the cutting edge of consulting and marketing?

Are you motivated by developing new insights into issues and developing sound recommendations that add real value to clients?

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Analyst JR to provide efficient and flexible administrative support to the recruitment process. The HR Analyst responsibilities include providing administrative assistance to our recruiting team and maintaining databases with candidate information. You will help keep our hiring process smooth and ensure we recruit and retain high-performing personnel.

ABOUT YOU

  • From 1-3 years of experience in HR as an Analyst or Talent Acquisition Analyst
  • Take initiative and work independently
  • Always willing to learn
  • Build and maintain partnerships
  • Strong problem solving
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills along with an ability to interact and develop networks in a professional manner externally & across the business
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Experience using professional social networks (LinkedIn, in particular)
  • Experience using different recruitment sources (Indeed, Zip Recruiter, LinkedIn, University platforms, etc.)
  • Must be a detail- and customer-oriented team player with excellent organizational and follow-up skills
  • Advanced English level is a must
  • Conversational Spanish is a great plus

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Understand the requirements of each client and each vacancy to support recruitment process according to their needs.
  • Support the sourcing process that includes posting job openings on various job boards, headhunting, use of social networks, filtering of CVs, and contact with candidates.
  • Support full-cycle recruiting process including interviews, technical exams, presentation, onboarding
  • Maintain a complete record of interviews

WHAT WE OFFER?

  • Be part of an international consulting company.
  • Exposure to multiple types of projects with people from all over Latin America
  • A results-oriented approach, cultivated in all our collaborators
  • Exposure to key decision makers in the industry in Latin America
  • An exciting and professional work environment
  • An indefinite independent contract
  • 80% remote
  • And of course... Attract the best talent worldwide!!!

title: Analista de Avaliação Jr - AFIRMATIVA PARA PESSOAS NEGRAS OU PARDAS.
description:
Descrição da vaga

Red Balloon:

A Red Balloon é uma rede de escolas de inglês especializada em crianças e adolescentes e faz parte do maior grupo educacional privado do Brasil: a Cogna! Mais que aulas, a Red Balloon proporciona experiências em inglês em diversos contextos. O aluno aprende o idioma com prazer e naturalidade, propiciando fluência para a vida toda. Fundada em 1969, a Red Balloon se destacou por oferecer, desde o início, além do ensino de inglês, atividades artísticas, culinária, teatro e música. Hoje a rede possui mais de 100 unidades em todo o Brasil.

A Red Balloon faz parte da Saber , que compõe a rede Cogna . A Saber oferece soluções para instituições que queiram iniciar suas atividades ou aumentar seu Market Share na modalidade de ensino à distância. Vem fazer parte! #AquiéCogna

Editorial:

A Saber faz parte do Grupo Cogna Educação, uma das principais organizações educacionais do mundo. Nossas soluções abrangem o ambiente virtual completo de aprendizagem, tutoria especializada, material pedagógico, amplo portfólio de cursos, atendimento ao estudante, BackOffice de pagamento e monitoramento da jornada de alunos.

Nesta vaga você irá atuar no Programa Nacional de Livros Didáticos ( PNLD ) com as editoras Ática e Scipione , com a oferta de livros didáticos para mais de 118 mil escolas públicas em todo o país.

É uma super oportunidade de mudar a educação no Brasil para melhor! #AquiéCogna

Como será seu dia a dia:

O time de Avaliações é responsável pela produção de provas, simulados e avaliações institucionais em larga escala — como ENEM, SAEB e vestibulares — além de apoiar a elaboração de instrumentos avaliativos para diferentes áreas da companhia. É um time colaborativo, dinâmico e com forte integração entre as equipes, atuando com foco em qualidade e cumprimento rigoroso de prazos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Atuar como editor(a) de avaliações, sendo responsável pela gestão completa do processo de criação e editoração dos simulados e provas da companhia;

Administrar cronogramas e etapas de produção, desde a compra de questões até a entrega final do material;

Fazer a mediação com prestadores externos (freelancers, revisores e diagramadores);

Realizar revisões pontuais de questões e materiais conforme a área de formação (Ciências Humanas);

Prestar suporte técnico ao time em demandas ligadas à área de expertise (História ou Geografia);

Apoiar análises de dados educacionais e outras demandas relacionadas à área de avaliação.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação completa em Ciências Humanas — História ou Geografia;

Licenciatura obrigatória (bacharelado apenas não atende ao requisito);

Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Word e Excel);

Boa organização, atenção a detalhes e foco em prazos;

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe, com facilidade para interações constantes em ambiente remoto;

É considerado um diferencial:

Experiência prévia com editoração de materiais;

Vivência com avaliações educacionais e/ou elaboração de questões;

Experiência com material didático;

Conhecimento básico em análise de dados educacionais.

Informações adicionais:

Modelo de trabalho híbrido ou 100%Remoto.

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Tech Lead | Design System e HTML5
description:
Como Tech Lead com foco em Design System e HTML5 na Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na arquitetura e evolução do framework de front-end da nossa aplicação.

Sua missão será liderar decisões técnicas, definir padrões e garantir a qualidade do nosso Design System, trabalhando lado a lado com UI/UX designers e times de desenvolvimento. Você será a principal referência técnica para o front-end, com forte atuação em mentoria, padronização de código e excelência em experiência do usuário.

Se você tem expertise avançada em React, HTML5, CSS3 e Design System, além de visão estratégica e habilidade para conduzir equipes, essa oportunidade é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar decisões técnicas do framework de front-end da aplicação.
  • Garantir qualidade, padronização e boas práticas no desenvolvimento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com UI/UX designers para manter a coerência visual e fortalecer o Design System.
  • Antecipar problemas técnicos e propor soluções escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Manter documentação técnica e material de onboarding atualizados.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e mentoria da equipe, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento front-end e liderança técnica.
  • Histórico de participação em projetos escaláveis e altamente performáticos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Portfólio técnico relevante (GitHub, projetos, contribuições open source).

Competências Técnicas

  • React (Framework/Library):
  • Domínio completo do React: hooks, context API, lifecycle, components, JSX, BFF (Backend for Frontend), etc.
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado: Redux, Zustand, Recoil, Context, etc.
  • Conhecimento de React Router, Lazy Loading, Code Splitting e SSR (Next.js).
  • Práticas modernas: Componentização, Atomic Design, Design System.
  • Conhecimento sólido de JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript.
  • Experiência com testes: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Robot Framework.
  • HTML5 / CSS3:
  • Domínio das semânticas do HTML5 e práticas de acessibilidade (WCAG, ARIA).
  • Uso avançado de CSS3, incluindo Flexbox, Grid, transições, animações.
  • Experiência com pré-processadores e frameworks: SASS, Tailwind, Styled-Components, Emotion.
  • Complementares:
  • Domínio de uso do framework StencilJs (Diferencial)
  • Aplicação da IA para desenvolvimento, revisão, testes, gestão, etc.
  • Integração com APIs REST e GraphQL.
  • CI/CD, DevOps básico (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Actions).
  • Conhecimento básico de backend (Java, Node.js, Express) é um diferencial.
  • Disposição em trabalhar com tecnologias legadas: Angular, Flash, etc.

Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução do Design System e definir o futuro da experiência front-end da Sankhya, queremos te conhecer!

description:

title: Líder Desenvolvimento Técnico
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um (a) Líder Desenvolvimento Técnico para atuar no time de Desenvolvimento Técnico na Unidade São José.

Quais as responsabilidades?

- Planejar, instalar e conduzir plano de monitoramento de pragas e doenças do canavial;

- Acompanhar e validar testes de campos experimentais;

- Realizar coleta de amostras em geral;

- Monitorar sanidade de viveiros.

Quais os requisitos?

Formação em Técnico Agrícola e/ou Ensino Superior

Experiência em operações agrícolas;

Vivência na liderança de pessoas;

CNH B;

Residir em Colina, Barretos, Severínia ou Olímpia.

Qual localidade?

Colina/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior - People Analytics
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e se colocando à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz mais limpa.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior – People Analytics para fazer parte do nosso time de Soluções de RH.

Estruturar a área de dados de RH, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e integração de dados.

Desenvolver análises e indicadores que conectem a estratégia de pessoas ao negócio, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Atuar como referência técnica desde a arquitetura de dados até a entrega de insights práticos e aplicáveis, propondo melhorias e apoiando a sustentação a cultura de dados para gestão de pessoas.

  • Garantir governança, padronização e consistência das bases de dados, definindo critérios e regras para indicadores, validando fontes, documentando metodologias e revisando rotinas de atualização;
  • Conduzir análises descritivas e preditivas para antecipar riscos e oportunidades em temas de pessoas;

  • Apoiar a definição de métricas estratégicas (KPIs e OKRs de People) alinhadas aos objetivos da companhia;
  • Fornecer insumos analíticos para projetos transversais de RH (remuneração, cultura, engajamento, T&D, planejamento de pessoas);
  • Apoiar lideranças de RH e do negócio como parceiro de dados, conectando análises às necessidades reais de gestão;
  • Atuar como referência em dados de RH, sendo fonte confiável para a formação da cultura de dados na empresa.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Tecnologia e Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Data Analytics, Business Intelligence ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e ferramentas de modelagem e visualização de dados (Power BI, Alteryx e/ou equivalentes);
  • SQL básico para manipulação de dados (desejável Python ou R);
  • Boa compreensão dos processos de RH (recrutamento, performance, folha de pagamento, benefícios, engajamento, desenvolvimento etc.);

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico sobre integração de sistemas para coleta e entrega de dados;
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada e análise preditiva;

title: Especialista em Análise de Riscos e Dados (Risk Analytics)
description:
Sobre a área

A área de Risk Analytics atua como um elo entre Engenharia de Dados e as áreas de Negócios da Seguradora. Nosso propósito é transformar dados em inteligência analítica para apoiar decisões estratégicas em Subscrição, Crédito, Operações, Mercado e Sinistros .

Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar dados e vontade de gerar impacto real no negócio, essa oportunidade é para você!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Será responsável pelo tratamento e governança dos dados, assegurando integridade, consistência e rastreabilidade das informações utilizadas nas análises. Atuará no desenvolvimento e validação de modelos analíticos e preditivos, aplicando técnicas de estatística e machine learning para mensurar frequência e severidade de sinistros, inadimplência, provisões técnicas e riscos de crédito.

Também dará suporte à gestão de riscos e solvência, participando da elaboração de indicadores regulatórios (SCR, MCR, VaR e stress tests) e da modelagem de cenários de risco operacional e de liquidez. Além disso, será responsável pela visualização e comunicação analítica dos resultados, construindo dashboards em Power BI ou Tableau e traduzindo análises técnicas em insights claros para a diretoria e áreas de negócio.

Terá interação constante com as áreas internas da seguradora, apoiando com dados, indicadores e análises que ajudem a compreender os detratores de risco e identificar oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Mandatory Experience

  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.

  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.

title: Supervisor de manutenção predial
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO:

Supervisiona e realiza trabalhos técnicos e mecânicos que garantem que os ambientes internos e externos dos prédios, terrenos, áreas comuns e comodidades da comunidade atendam aos padrões da Empresa em relação à limpeza, aparência, segurança e funcionalidade geral.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Auxilia e executa ordens de serviço geradas por solicitações dos moradores, bem como manutenção de rotina na comunidade, diagnosticando a origem ou causa do defeito ou problema e realizando os reparos de acordo com as políticas, procedimentos, normas de segurança e exigências do código estabelecidos.

• Supervisiona e conclui o processo de preparação (“make-ready”) das unidades desocupadas para locação e novos moradores, realizando a inspeção pré-desocupação, criando uma lista de manutenção necessária, agendando fornecedores e prestadores de serviço conforme necessário, adquirindo os materiais e suprimentos necessários, realizando todas as tarefas de manutenção e inspecionando o trabalho concluído.

• Desenvolve padrões para a limpeza e aparência geral das áreas externas da comunidade, comodidades, fachadas dos edifícios, interiores das unidades prontas para locação, corredores, calçadas, placas, escritório de locação, áreas centrais de lixo, estacionamentos e outras construções e áreas comuns, garantindo que reflitam a alta qualidade da comunidade e os padrões da Greystar.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por outros membros da equipe de manutenção para avaliar a eficácia das políticas e procedimentos e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva conforme necessário.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por empreiteiros, fornecedores e outros prestadores de serviços para verificar se os serviços, materiais e mão de obra atendem aos padrões de qualidade, escopo e especificações exigidas.

• Mantém inventário adequado de peças de reposição e materiais de manutenção, trabalhando com o Gerente da Comunidade para encomendar suprimentos e ferramentas conforme necessário, respeitando os limites orçamentários.

• Executa os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva mensalmente conforme descrito no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoia programas de economia e controle de despesas consertando, sempre que possível, ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdício de materiais e suprimentos e utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos corretamente.

• Realiza reuniões regulares de segurança da Greystar, garante que todas as fichas MSDS estejam atualizadas e acessíveis, e mantém-se informado sobre todas as exigências e legislações de segurança da OSHA e outras entidades para garantir a conformidade da comunidade.

CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem fornecer suas próprias ferramentas manuais, salvo quando proibido pela legislação estadual, e devem ter conhecimento e habilidades no uso e manutenção seguros de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, equipamentos mecânicos e dispositivos de medição.

• Capacidade demonstrada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para definir e corrigir problemas.

• Proficiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades de comunicação interpessoal para interagir eficazmente com moradores, clientes, colegas de equipe e outros contatos profissionais, respondendo com cortesia a perguntas e solicitações e mantendo a calma ao lidar com problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz para representar a gestão da empresa em funções de apoio, atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para colegas de equipe internos e visitantes externos, e responder a perguntas relacionadas às políticas operacionais do departamento.

• Proficiência demonstrada em programas de internet, processamento de texto, planilhas e gerenciamento de banco de dados para manter registros e desenvolver informações para uso do gestor. (Experiência com sistemas de gestão imobiliária é preferida.)

• Capacidade de operar máquinas básicas de escritório, como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de selos postais e sistemas telefônicos com várias linhas.

• Habilidades matemáticas necessárias para somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir números, decimais e frações para revisar e preencher documentos financeiros, administrativos e legais.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

LICENÇAS OU CERTIFICAÇÕES EXIGIDAS:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem possuir todas as certificações exigidas pelas jurisdições estaduais e locais.

VIAGENS / EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Os membros da equipe trabalham em ambiente de escritório ou remoto. Nenhuma exigência física especial é necessária.

• Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser exigidas para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias para o cumprimento de algumas ou todas as responsabilidades diárias deste cargo.

Sobre a Greystar

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, oferecendo expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para locação de padrão institucional, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul, a Greystar gerencia e opera mais de US$ 290 bilhões em imóveis em 247 mercados globalmente, com escritórios em toda a América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região da Ásia-Pacífico. A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, administra mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos em todo o mundo e possui uma robusta plataforma institucional de gestão de investimentos, com mais de US$ 76 bilhões em ativos sob gestão, incluindo mais de US$ 34 bilhões em ativos em desenvolvimento. A Greystar foi fundada por Bob Faith em 1993 com o objetivo de se tornar uma prestadora de serviços de classe mundial no setor imobiliário residencial para locação. Para saber mais, acesse .

title: Senior Technical Manager - Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives

Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency

Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.

Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations

Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment

Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction

Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)

Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge

Why Join Us

✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

✅ Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

✅ Competitive Package: Industry-leading compensation aligned with performance outcomes

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.

Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.

Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.

Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).

Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.

Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.

Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.

Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.

Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.

Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.

CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Senior Support Specialist to provide advanced technical support for users and systems within a corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID (Azure AD), and user support through ticketing systems. This professional will also handle basic Windows and Linux server maintenance and perform network troubleshooting as needed. The role involves ensuring service stability, maintaining system integrity, and collaborating with infrastructure and security teams to improve operational efficiency and end-user experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for users, resolving incidents and service requests via the ticketing system.
  • Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, and access permissions in Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Perform basic maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers. Support network-related issues such as connectivity, DHCP, DNS, and VPN access.
  • Document technical procedures, configurations, and solutions. Collaborate with other IT teams on escalations, system improvements

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proven experience in IT support, preferably in corporate or enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID (Azure AD). Basic understanding of Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Basic knowledge of network concepts (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Experience with IT ticketing systems and customer support.
  • Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-900, MD-102, AZ-104).
  • Experience with automation tools such as PowerShell or scripting.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices or similar support frameworks.

Excellent communication skills and a proactive, problem-solving attitude.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Technical Sales Manager (Master Brewer)
description:
About the role

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.
  • Establish a high level of customer intimacy and build trusted, strategic relationships to drive continued value.
  • Develop and maintain customer success strategies and share best practices across commercial teams.
  • Ensure alignment with Kerry’s alcoholic beverage strategy in LATAM, with a specific focus on beer brewing.
  • Travel to client sites across LATAM at least 70% of the time to support implementation, relationship building, and technical collaboration.

Qualifications and skills

  • Degree in Brewing Science, Fermentation Science, Food Science, or a related field (preferred).

  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and project management skills.
  • Analytical and process-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working across multiple departments in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Active team player, self-starter, and multitasker with the ability to quickly adjust priorities.
  • Passion for craft beer and innovation.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate

São Paulo, Brazil

About Divibank:

At Divibank, we are developing the leading platform for online businesses in Latin America, combining

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.

This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.

About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the processes of proposal generation, KYC (Know Your Customer), and client

onboarding, ensuring agility and clear communication with all relevant teams.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, ensuring an efficient onboarding process,

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

  • Oversee customer support operations using CX tools to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

  • Monitor transaction data and chargebacks, quickly identifying fraud risks and implementing

corrective actions.

  • Handle chargeback response cases, supporting clients to timely respond with the necessary

information.

  • Work together with our Treasury to ensure client settlements are working according to plan.
  • Run credit card receivable assignment operations, either for discounting or for collection

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Map and review operational workflows and data to identify gaps and propose improvements,

whether through process adjustments, the implementation of third-party tools, or development

suggestions for internal product and tech teams.

  • Collaborate with technology and product teams to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in

a timely manner.

  • Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs and ensure their satisfaction with

our services.

  • Work closely with the sales and product teams to align customer success initiatives to optimize

customer journey

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.

What qualifications we need:

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, customer success, or a related role, preferably within the

fintech, payments or consulting industries.

  • Bachelor’s degree (completed or in progress) in relevant fields (Business Administration,

Engineering, etc.).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) and operations tools.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and business orientation
  • Positive, willing to get hands dirty and proactive attitude
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize in ambiguous situations
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in English (verbal and written)

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in Fintech or online Payments industry
  • Basic understanding of APIs or technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineers
  • Knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Looker.

Personal attitudes we look for:

  • You get sh*t done!
  • You do whatever it takes to get things moving and completed
  • You have an ownership mentality, are energetic, and bring the best out of others
  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences
  • Everyone understands what your priorities and objectives are
  • You organize and break down complex problems into simple tasks
  • You can think structurally and identify bottlenecks
  • You balance and align your short and long-term priorities with Divibank’s goals
  • You are curious and have a growth mindset
  • You are always learning and growing (even outside of work)
  • You take risks, learn from failures quickly and apply lessons learned
  • You are quietly confident and openly humble
  • You are confident in your abilities, and are not afraid to step up when needed
  • You respect the backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking of others

Key Benefits:

  • Amil Health and dental insurances
  • Competitive salary
  • Chance of earning equity at Divibank
  • Flexible paid vacation
  • Totalpass

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You’ll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo’s growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo’s operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo’s mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: QHSE Coordinator
description:
About the Company

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decor paper for surface finishing on wood-based panels.

Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments , always driven by innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility .

We develop and deliver innovative and customized decorative paper solutions , which, after further processing, are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

At Munksjö, we believe that taking responsibility for the future of our planet is a priority — sustainability is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are seeking a QHSE Coordinator with proven focus on environmental management to join our team in Caieiras-SP.

This professional will be responsible for ensuring the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QHSE systems and practices, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and performance .

The role plays a key part in promoting a sustainability-driven culture , ensuring alignment with environmental legislation, corporate goals, and best practices .

Responsibilities

Environmental Management

  • Plan, implement, and monitor sustainability and environmental management programs.
  • Track and analyze environmental KPIs (emissions, effluents, waste, energy, and water consumption).
  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and licenses.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external audits.
  • Lead environmental impact mitigation and carbon neutrality projects.
  • Develop environmental awareness and engagement campaigns.
  • Oversee supplier and partner compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Lead strategic environmental initiatives (e.g., zero landfill, waste segregation).
  • Support occupational health and safety programs and accident prevention initiatives.
  • Monitor HSE indicators and propose corrective/preventive actions.
  • Maintain and enhance the Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Coordinate QHSE training and awareness activities.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero accidents.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Degree in Environmental Engineering, Production Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Environmental Management, Sustainability, or related areas (preferred).
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in QHSE, with proven focus on environmental management.
  • Experience in multinational organizations, interacting with corporate and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading environmental projects.

Technical Knowledge:

  • Brazilian environmental legislation.
  • Waste, effluent, and emission management.
  • Continuous improvement and risk analysis tools.
  • Environmental and sustainability performance indicators (ESG).
  • Understanding of GHG Scopes 1, 2, and 3.

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

Sobre a vaga

Family Office: setor voltado ao acompanhamento e à organização dos assuntos dos acionistas.

Atribuições:

  • Fechamento contábil mensal das empresas nacionais e internacionais (balanço, DRE, DLPA, DFC), analisar contas patrimoniais e de resultado,identificar e corrigir inconsistências;
  • Suporte na geração de relatórios contábeis;
  • Escrituração contábil e conferência de documentos;
  • Apurar resultado contábil e preparar balancetes mensais;
  • Conferir integração contábil de notas fiscais, pagamentos e movimentações bancárias, atuar junto à área financeira para esclarecimentos de lançamentos e conciliações;
  • Fornecer relatórios contábeis sob demanda com linguagem acessível;
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias, de contas contábeis e razão;
  • Organizar e manter arquivos contábeis digitais por entidade e competência;
  • Garantir cumprimento dos prazos legais;
  • Apoiar a geração e revisão de informes de rendimento e IRPF;
  • Garantir aderência às normas contábeis (BR GAAP e, se aplicável, IFRS);
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com documentação e explicações técnicas;
  • Entrega de obrigações acessórias (SPED Contábil, entre outros).

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência em ERPs contábil;
  • Conhecimentos de IFRS e normas brasileiras;
  • Experiência em escrituração contábil completa (preferencialmente em empresas com múltiplos CNPJs);
  • Experiência com ECD e ECF obrigatória;
  • Desejável conhecimento de estruturas de holding, investimentos e contabilidade patrimonial;
  • Domínio do pacote Office, especialmente Excel.

Benefícios:

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:
Senior Consultant - Treasury, Financial Transactions & Accounting

Fully remote position offering a flexible work schedule.

Location: LATAM (Brazil)

You’ll work with top-tier clients across industries - multinationals, banks, and government entities. You're not just executing tasks, you’re leading workstreams, shaping recommendations, and driving change in treasury organizations.

About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.

Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

Desired Skills:

• Experience in financial services or corporate treasury environment

• Solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling is a plus.

• System/software implementation experience

• Exposure to financial instruments including derivatives, funding, and investments

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.

Contact/application information:

Please submit your resume to . If accepted, we’ll be in touch to schedule an interview. 

Thank you!

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager-Contact Center

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Work from office.

Office location: near Santo Amaro Station / Giovani Gronchi. Sao Paulo | Brazil – CENESP

Salary: BRL 10,000/month- BRL 12,000/month

The Operations Manager of a contact center oversees daily operations, manages staff, and ensures high-quality customer service while optimizing efficiency and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee Daily Operations: Manage the overall operations of the contact center, ensuring that all processes run smoothly and efficiently.
  • Staff Management: Supervise, train, and mentor customer service representatives, providing feedback and coaching to improve performance.
  • Performance Monitoring: Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of operations and implement strategies for improvement.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Ensure that customer service goals are met, focusing on enhancing the customer experience and resolving complex inquiries or complaints.
  • Budget Management: Manage the contact center budget, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively to meet operational needs.
  • Process Improvement: Develop and implement operational procedures to optimize efficiency and productivity within the contact center.
  • Technology Implementation: Drive the adoption of technology solutions to enhance contact center performance and streamline operations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless customer service experience and address any operational challenges.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience: 10-15 years of proven experience as a Contact Center Operations Manager or in a similar role within customer service.
  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage and motivate a team.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and trends to make informed decisions and drive performance improvements.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with contact center technologies and software to manage operations effectively.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities to address issues quickly and efficiently.

Work Environment:

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

title: Supervisor de Instalações Industriais
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira que nasceu da vontade e do esforço de empreendedores em inovar de forma sustentável, valorizando a vida e oferecendo produtos e serviços que aquecem, alimentam e movem o país inteiro. Vamos construir um amanhã melhor, energizando o Brasil inteiro a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 24 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

  • Atuar tecnicamente junto à área comercial e clientes em demandas técnicas de instalações industriais;
  • Realizar viagens em toda área de abrangência da supervisão de instalações industriais;

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento das normas regulamentadoras (NR);
  • Conhecimento sistema SAP;
  • Conhecimento sistema Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento de tubulação e conexões;

Tipo de contratação: Efetivo - CLT - 100% presencial.

Localidade: Jardinópolis - SP

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos:
